Package org.dreambot.api.methods.construction

Class Furniture

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.Furniture
  • public class Furniture
extends java.lang.Object
    Finds furniture hotspots and builds or removes pieces. XPE class.

      All Methods Static Methods Concrete Methods 
      Modifier and Type Method Description
      org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject hotspot​(org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.Piece piece)
      Gets the nearest empty hotspot for the piece, skipping similarly named hotspots from other rooms. XPE method.
      org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject hotspot​(java.lang.String name)
      Gets the nearest object with the given name and the Build action. Does not distinguish names shared across rooms. XPE method.
      org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject built​(org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.Piece piece)
      Gets the nearest built piece with Remove. Oak dungeon doors also match IDs 13344 and 13345. XPE method.
      boolean build​(org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.Piece piece)
      Builds the piece on its nearest hotspot. Returns true if the piece appears on that tile or the unnoted plank count drops. XPE method.
      boolean build​(org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject hotspot, org.dreambot.api.methods.construction.Piece piece)
      Builds the piece on the supplied hotspot. Returns true if the piece appears on that tile or the unnoted plank count drops. XPE method.
      boolean build​(org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject hotspot, java.lang.String menuLabel)
      Builds the named entry on the supplied hotspot. A missing entry returns false and leaves the menu open. For a label not in Piece, success requires a new Remove object on the hotspot tile. XPE method.
      boolean remove​(org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject piece)
      Removes the piece and confirms Yes. If Yes is absent, logs the choices without clicking another option. XPE method.
